title: Patient Welfare
description: Financial assistance, admission guidance, welfare programs, and patient rights at Hijaz Hospital.

hero.title: Financial & Community Support
hero.excerpt: Hijaz Hospital is committed to ensuring that financial hardship does not prevent deserving patients from receiving essential medical care. Through its Shariah-Compliant Zakat Management System and charitable welfare programs, the hospital provides financial assistance to eligible patients with fairness, dignity, and compassion.
